title: 디자이어 미 이프 유 캔(Desire Me If You Can) (15세 개정판)

Desire me If You Can; Zig.
Complex characters with an interesting relationship dynamic: one seeks and professes love but cannot find it, while the other runs away at the sound of the words "I love you."
It tells us that sometimes love is not just about saying "I love you" — it's about understanding and showing that you love that person, and that their well-being and happiness might be with you or without you. Learning to let go is also a form of love.
